theorem lg_target (p : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ p) (h1 : p ≤ 1) : p * (1 - p) ≤ 1 / 4 := by
  have h2 : 0 ≤ 1 - p := by rw [sub_nonneg]; exact le_trans h1 (le_refl 1)
  have h3 : 0 ≤ 1 := by norm_num
  have h4 : 0 ≤ 1 / 4 := by norm_num
  have h5 : p * (1 - p) ≤ ((p + (1 - p)) / 2) * ((p + (1 - p)) / 2) :=
    calc
      p * (1 - p) ≤ ((p + (1 - p)) / 2) * ((p + (1 - p)) / 2) :=
        (mul_le_mul' (le_of_lt (lt_one_of_le h1)) (le_of_lt (lt_one_of_le h1)) (le_refl 1) (le_refl 1))
  have h6 : ((p + (1 - p)) / 2) * ((p + (1 - p)) / 2) = 1 / 4 :=
    by simp [add_right_comm, add_comm, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, mul_inv_eq_inv_mul]
  exact (le_trans h5 h6)
